One route, every mode

Air Cargo

Drayage

Dedicated Support

One point of contact managing the load from pickup to delivery.

17
Years of Experience

Backed by 17 years of hands-on freight industry experience, JH Freight Inc was built to give shippers a single, dependable point of contact — no matter which mode a load needs. We know what it takes to keep freight moving: vetted carriers, clear communication, and a team that stays responsive when a load needs attention. From a single truckload to a multi-leg international shipment, we plan the route, confirm the carrier, and stay on top of the load until it's delivered and signed for.

Where We Operate

Nationwide coverage, every lane

JH Freight coordinates freight across the continental U.S., with an established carrier network linking major hubs coast to coast.

Global Reach

Coordinated at every handoff, across every mode

Ocean, air, and ground freight each move through their own network of ports, airports, rail yards, and terminals — and the handoff between them is where shipments tend to stall. Whether a container is coming off a vessel, cargo is being pulled from a plane, or a load is transferring from rail to truck, we track it through every step so it keeps moving instead of sitting idle waiting on a phone call. One shipment or a recurring multimodal lane, our team manages the handoffs between carrier, terminal, and final destination.
